description:
APP Kirrane Auctioneering are delighted to bring to the market this exceptional four bedroom semi-detached property, superbly located in the small and friendly residential development of Carrowmore Drive, Knock, Co. Mayo.

This beautifully presented home offers an excellent opportunity for those seeking a high quality, turnkey property in a peaceful and welcoming community, while remaining within easy reach of an extensive range of amenities and major towns. 

The property enjoys an enviable position overlooking a beautifully manicured green area to the front, with views towards the renowned Knock Shrine.  The exterior is exceptionally well maintained, with a beautifully painted facade, off street parking to the front and a private rear garden, making this an ideal home for families, first time buyers or those looking for a property requiring nothing further to do.

Internally, the property has been finished and maintained to an exceptionally high standard throughout, with tasteful decor and a modern presentation.  Accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hall with staircase leading to the first floor sleeping accommodation, a large and bright sitting room with front aspect window overlooking the green area, and a superb open plan kitchen dining area.  The kitchen is modern, stylish and finished to a very high standard, creating an excellent space for both everyday family living and entertaining.  A separate utility room with rear access and a beautifully presented downstairs guest WC complete the ground floor.

Upstairs, the property offers a spacious landing with access to the attic area, together with a shelved hot press.  There are three generous double bedrooms, including a superb master bedroom with built-in wardrobes and a stylish en-suite, along with a further single bedroom.  A family sized bathroom, finished and presented to an excellent standard, completes the first floor.  

The location is another major attraction.  Situated in the Marian Village of Knock, the property is within walking distance of local schools, cafes, the post office and convenience shop, while the world renowned Knock Shrine is also close by.  For commuters, the property is ideally positioned within approximately 10 minutes' drive to Ballyhaunis, Claremorris, Kiltimagh and Ireland West Airport Knock.  The surrounding area also offers an excellent selection of recreational amenities, including scenic walking routes, fishing lakes, golf courses and the renowned GAA Centre of Excellence.

The property's central location also places it within approximately an hour of Sligo, Galway, Athlone and Westport, making it an excellent choice for commuting families, professionals of students attending colleges and universities throughout the region.

This is a genuine turnkey home, owner occupied and presented in excellent condition throughout.  Properties of this quality and standard in such a convenient location rarely come to the market and viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate what this magnificent property has to offer.   For further information or to arrange a viewing please contact the Sole Selling Agents APP Kirrane Auctioneering where everything we touch turns to SOLD.
